comment: No source is published; read from the maker's manual. The five diagonal transition parameters (50, 56, 62, 68, 74) are configured but have no widget position in the census, so they get no line. Gate Length and Swing are menu-only parameters with no position and are untagged. The manual's figure of eight note blocks does not match this build, whose sequencer class is BaseStarMatrix<5> and which configures five blocks.
